observations.summary: Reuters reports Putin publicly rejected a possible halt to strikes on shipping and energy facilities after repeated Kerch Bridge attacks, threatened stronger retaliation, and Russian-installed authorities announced replacement ferry service. This is a policy reversal and protective logistics response, not evidence that additional strikes have already occurred. Article was updated after initial publication; exact statement time is not established.
observations.title: Putin rejects proposed maritime and energy strike moratorium after Kerch Bridge attacks

observations.summary: Reuters reports Saudi Civil Defence acknowledged Houthi-related damage to multiple floors and nearby buildings, with no injuries, and that King Abdullah Financial District closed to visitors. This materially clarifies physical and protective consequences of the Riyadh attack already flagged in the preceding scan; not a second attack. Exact timing of the closure and updated detail is unavailable.
observations.title: Saudi civil defence confirms PIF Tower damage and financial district closure
